newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Zurich takes minority stake in Thai Met.
newsitem.headline: Zurich takes minority stake in Thai Met.

text.p: Zurich Group, Switzerland, said on Monday it has acquired a minority stake in Thai Metropole Insurance Co, Ltd.
The privately-owned Thai insurer had a premium volume in 1996 of $70 million. It has 46 branches and representative offices in Thailand, Zurich said.
The Thai company will gain immediate access to Zurich's worldwide network, and Zurich's existing international and corporate business in Thailand will, over time, be transferred to Thai Metropole.
The company will be renamed Thai Metropole Zurich Insurance company, Zurich said. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
